findings.diagnosis: The abstract is missing, so the first-page reader cannot recover the paper's problem, gap, idea, evidence, or boundary.
findings.reader_friction: The reader starts the paper without a map of what belief should change.
findings.writing_principle: 改变读者理解状态; first-page reader test.
findings.next_draft_task: Write an abstract that states problem, gap, idea, evidence, and boundary without increasing claim strength.
findings.severity_rationale: A missing abstract breaks first-page recoverability for a full-paper review.

findings.title: Table 1 Method A numeric signal is not reproducible from visible cells
findings.diagnosis: In Table 1, the Method A signal reports 95.77 while the visible arithmetic mean of the preceding cells is 95.52; the manuscript must explain any weighted/micro aggregation before this can support the claim.
findings.reader_friction: A reader who recomputes the visible cells cannot reproduce the displayed summary value.
findings.writing_principle: 不要让读者做算术题; explicit denominator and aggregation.
findings.next_draft_task: State the aggregation denominator/procedure or correct the visible summary value.
findings.severity_rationale: The affected number is in a main evidence table; the signal is concrete but aggregation may be weighted.
findings.downgrade_condition: The paper documents a valid weighted/micro aggregation or updates the table.
findings.aggregation_caveat: visible arithmetic mean only; weighted/micro average or hidden denominator may differ
